top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single part for GLP-1 physiology to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. The chain is complete: proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, glucose-dependent insulin secretion, and central and gastric effects. It has been independently confirmed for decades and is supported by large outcome trials in glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal disease. The three-name allocation and a citation limited to physiology and active forms keep the scope defensible, and no award would withhold a mature, well-documented achievement.
